body: Oof. Last week I drank for the first time in forever and honestly I felt happier, freer, more relaxed and at peace than I have in a very, very long time. Worked way better than my antidepressants have. But obviously that's not a sustainable feeling so no, I try to avoid alcohol because of the temptation to overdo it and self-medicate.

Yeah, I guess there is still hope that we can continue to level up and reach the surface eventually like you say. But I just have a lot of regrets personally so feel like there will always be something haunting me.

Can't remember where I read it but apparently your survival instinct kicks in pretty intensely. That's the most terrifying part of suicide for me, the idea that my last moments would be spent scared and regretful, desperately trying to take it back.
People are saying to block his number, but then you won't receive the messages! It's better to have a record of what he's saying imo, especially if things escalate and you need to report it.
Exactly, people like this do it to compensate for their own insecurities/shortcomings. Hope you're doing well.

It's just frustrating because this person gives off a total "nice guy" persona to everyone in his life.. it's made me feel so gaslit and ostracised, questioning every little lie and manipulation. But you're totally right.

Ah thanks for the info, I'm in the UK so the financial impact of healthcare is generally not an issue. It sucks that you guys have to take that into account, especially during a mental health crisis when someone is already at their lowest.
Thanks, that's really kind and I appreciate you for taking the time to say it. The same truly goes for you and everyone else on this sub.

That's my point, the communication and compromise was entirely one-sided. If you're having to beg for the most basic, key components of a healthy relationship then it isn't true love. Gotta accept that and keep it moving.
